purpose: Emit the invite_lifecycle 'accepted' announcement exactly once per invitee/group, gated on B's genuine own-join (DD-9): the arriving profile rumor's transport senderPubkey must equal the signed author AND a pending-direct-invite marker must have existed for that author at arrival. A third-member relay of B's cached profile (senderPubkey != author) or a repeat delivery after the marker is already cleared must never (re-)fire the post.

public_api.name: createProfileHandler
public_api.description: Unchanged export shape. ProfileHandlerDeps gains two fields (hasPendingDirectInvite, sendAnnouncement) consumed additively by the accept-producer gate; the pre-existing merge/clear/notify/writeContactEntry behavior is untouched.

public_api.name: buildAcceptedAnnouncementContent
public_api.description: Pure builder for the JSON.stringify'd {type:'invite_lifecycle', event:'accepted', pubkey} content, canonicalizing pubkey to lowercase hex. Mirrors S2's buildInvitedAnnouncementContent precedent; constructs the InviteLifecycleContent shape directly rather than importing parseStructured.ts (no cross-module import into 'parse').

public_api.name: ProfileHandlerDeps.hasPendingDirectInvite
public_api.description: Read-only 'get' half of the get-then-clear seam: reports whether a pending-direct-invite marker exists for (groupId, pubkey) at the moment of the call, WITHOUT clearing it. Must be called before the pre-existing (unchanged) clearPendingDirectInvite call in handle() so it observes pre-clear state.

public_api.name: ProfileHandlerDeps.sendAnnouncement
public_api.description: Fire capability injected via registerHandlers.ts's registration seam (architecture.md: 'thread it through the registration seam — do not import a sender ad hoc'). Publishes the given content as a kind-9 (CHAT_MESSAGE_KIND) application rumor into the group this handler instance is bound to. Real implementation lives at the MarmotContext.tsx composition root (mirrors the existing sendSelfProfile closure's build+sendRumorSafe shape) — required (non-optional) so the no-op path is unreachable in production, not merely assumed-wired.

owned_data: the pending→joined transition detector (transport senderPubkey === signed author AND a pending marker existed at arrival)
dependencies_forbidden: parse (does not import parseStructured.ts; constructs the InviteLifecycleContent shape directly, matching S2's precedent)
external_ports: registerHandlers.ts's HandlerDeps.hasPendingDirectInvite / HandlerDeps.sendAnnouncement — new required fields threaded through buildDispatcher() into createProfileHandler()

MarmotContext.tsx's buildDispatcher({...}) call site — the sole real production wiring of the two new capabilities (necessary extension beyond this story's literal three-file list; see retrospective/return message: no other file in the codebase can supply mlsGroup/signer access for a real, non-optional send closure, matching the existing sendSelfProfile precedent at the same call site)
events_emitted: invite_lifecycle {event:'accepted', pubkey:B} application rumor (kind 9), at most once per (groupId, B)
events_consumed: PROFILE_RUMOR_KIND (kind 0) application rumor, via the existing profileHandler dispatch — no new inbound event type
